scope_note: Separate statements in thousands of soles (PEN). Santa Luisa pays a 5% royalty on concentrate sales to Mitsui Mining & Smelting Co. Ltd. Sucursal del Perú for the Pallca concessions (FS note 1; PER_SantaLuisa_AR_2016.pdf p.7). That branch is a second constituent entity of the same group in Peru, so the group's Peruvian upstream profit is higher than Santa Luisa's PBT by the branch's net royalty income (not published). Group PBT not stored (group net sales JPY 436-652bn; Santa Luisa is well under 1% of group profit, so the cap does not bind).

scope_note: Fully consolidated branch: 100% of the branch in Grupo Mexico's CbCR (SCC itself 88.9% owned by GM; NCI ~11% public). No low-tax intermediate holding (MEX -> MEX -> USA -> USA); Empresarios Industriales de Mexico S.A. de C.V. (Larrea family) holds 37.57% of GM (GroupReport p.3) - below 50%; any higher consolidator would also be Mexican, so filing country MEX is unaffected. MIXED PRODUCER: FS note 2(b) 'Informacion por segmentos' - the branch is managed and reported as one integrated production unit (mines, concentrators, SX-EW, Ilo smelter and refinery, precious-metals plant; copper ~88% of revenue), so the Ilo smelter/refinery margin (incl. some purchased third-party/related-party concentrate) cannot be separated and stays inside the PBT. The PBT also carries exploration/development spending on Tia Maria (Arequipa), Los Chancas (Apurimac) and Michiquillay (Cajamarca, acquired 2018) - development projects with no production, no separate rows. Separable = equity-method share of associates (Compania Minera Coimolache S.A., 44.24%, Tantahuatay gold mine - equity-accounted, not a constituent entity at 100%) + finance income. Statutory income-tax rate 28% (2016); SPCC has no tax-stability agreement and therefore pays the IEM (not the GEM) - FS note 'Regalias mineras e impuesto especial a la mineria': IEM 'no es aplicable a las empresas que tienen suscrito un Convenio de Estabilidad Tributaria'. ROYALTY_USD_M=16.224 (cash-flow line 'Regalias mineras'); DIVWHT_USD_M=29.838 (financing cash flow 'Impuesto a los dividendos remitidos a accionistas no domiciliadas' = withholding on profit remittances to the non-domiciled head office/investment-share holders). ITAN not shown separately (creditable against income tax; if paid it sits in the income-tax line). Grupo Mexico consolidated (US$ thousands /1,000): PBT US$2,294.190m ('Utilidad antes de impuestos a la utilidad', USA_GrupoMexico_AR_2016.pdf PDF p.114, printed 224-225 spread, Estados consolidados de resultados); income taxes paid US$485.256m ('Impuestos a la utilidad pagados', PDF p.116, printed 228-229 spread, Estados consolidados de flujos de efectivo). Southern Copper consolidated (USA_SouthernCopper_10K_2016.htm): earnings before taxes on income US$1,256.0m (Note 8 'Income taxes'); income taxes paid US$571.8m ('Supplemental disclosure of cash flow information - Cash paid during the year for: Income taxes').
